description: Distribución Eléctrica Edenor is a dataset listed in Argentine national open data portal (datos.gob.ar), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría de Energía. ISO 19126: DistributionNetworks, Este subgrupo se compone de conceptos que se relacionan con el transporte en las redes, tales como tuberías o canales, por encima o por debajo de la superficie. Coverage: Argentina. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría de Energía. Its tags are Alta tensión, Distribución, EDENOR, Eléctrica, Empalmes. It offers 20 resource(s) in CSV, SHP. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ar-portal.
